## What's new

### Smarter predictions, on your phone
A small AI language model now runs on the phone and helps guess your next word. It reads up to the last 32 words you typed and works together with the built-in dictionary and the words and phrases the keyboard has learned from you. Like everything else here, it runs offline: nothing you type leaves your phone.

In testing on sentences the keyboard had never seen:
- The next word shows up in the suggestions before you type a letter noticeably more often (about 29% → 35% in English, 22% → 24% in Hinglish), and much more often once you've typed its first letter.
- Glide typing picks the right word more often, especially in Hinglish.
- Autocorrect changes a word you typed correctly far less often.

It's on by default. If you'd rather not use it, turn off **Typing → Smarter predictions**.

### Predictions that sound like people
Next-word prediction is now also learned from everyday conversation and human-written chat, not only from written sentences, so casual messages get more natural suggestions.

### Fixes
- Undoing an autocorrect with the undo pill now stops that correction for good, as backspace already did. This includes fixed spellings like "im" and words undone at the start of a sentence.
- Search, go, send and the other enter actions send the word exactly as you typed it instead of autocorrecting it first. A new line still corrects.
- Moving the cursor into a word you're typing now suggests fixes for that word instead of predicting the next one.
- A glide that drifts off the letters before you lift still types its word.

### Good to know
- The app is now for 64-bit phones only (nearly every phone from the last several years). This keeps the download at 42 MB.
